title: The Console has one to-do page: CRM Tasks folds into Work

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25 in production: crm_tasks holds 29 rows and every one is a Plan to-do (plan_id set); zero are CRM call-backs. /admin/crm/tasks lists every Frequency-Space crm_tasks row under 'Your follow-up list', so it shows the same to-dos as /admin/work under a different name and description. Fix: /admin/crm/tasks redirects to /admin/work, the crm-tasks row leaves lib/nav/studio.ts, and a call-back made from a contact is a to-do that lands in Work.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
